definitions.explanation: The act of competing against or standing in opposition to someone or something. Implies actively matching or countering an opposing force.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大手|おおて}→大手：12171_oote⟧⟦{企業|きぎょう}→企業：00225_kigyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{対抗|たいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To compete against a major corporation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{値下|ねさ}げ→値下げ：07583_nesage⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{対抗|たいこう}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、うち⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{価格|かかく}→価格：00147_kakaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げた→下げる：00807_sageru⟧。
examples.english: In response to their price cut, we also lowered our prices.

examples.japanese: ⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧たち⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{再開発|さいかいはつ}→再開発：17066_saikaihatsu⟧⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{対抗|たいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{署名|しょめい}→署名：03682_shomei⟧⟦{活動|かつどう}→活動：00201_katsudou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: The residents started a petition drive to oppose the redevelopment plan.

notes:
USAGE:
{対抗|たいこう} functions as a ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ verb ({対抗|たいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧) and also appears frequently as a modifier: {対抗|たいこう}～ (counter-~, rival ~). The pattern ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{対抗|たいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to compete against ~, to counter ~) is very common.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{対決|たいけつ}→対決：12392_taiketsu⟧: showdown, confrontation (more direct and climactic)
- ⟦{対立|たいりつ}→対立：04500_tairitsu⟧: opposition, conflict (emphasis on the state of being opposed)
- ⟦{競争|きょうそう}→競争：01388_kyousou⟧: competition (neutral, ongoing rivalry)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ～⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{対抗|たいこう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to compete against ~, to counter ~
- {対抗|たいこう}⟦{措置|そち}→措置：05519_sochi⟧: countermeasure
- {対抗|たいこう}{馬|ば}: rival horse, strong contender
- {対抗|たいこう}{意識|いしき}: sense of rivalry
- {対抗|たいこう}{戦|せん}: rivalry match
